subject: Q3 KPI preflight: dashboard + OKR check & pre-QBR asks
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: (none)
Date: Tue, 5 Sep 2028 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Q3 KPI preflight: dashboard + OKR check & pre-QBR asks

Team — attaching the monthly KPI dashboard and the raw metrics CSV for the exec QBR next week. High level items I want us to own before the pre-read goes to execs: 

- Latency: EU p50/p95 nudged up ~10–15% over baseline last week (see sheet tab "latency_by_region"). Need a short root-cause note + whether we can keep current SLOs for the QBR slides.
- Cost: token spend increased ~12% month-over-month; a good chunk is model multiplexing during peak hours. We need a conservative month-end cost projection for the finance slide.
- Uptime: two brief platform flaps in APAC (both recovered <3m) but they affected a handful of L2 customers — include incident IDs if you think we should call them out.
- Usage: organic usage spike from one customer (Acme Health) caused a short-lived capacity stretch — see comments in the CSV under "top_consumers".

OKR check: Objective A (Reduce per-token cost) is at ~60% progress (see OKR tab). Please add quick notes if you think a KR needs re-baselining before the QBR.

Asks (can each owner reply with the items below by EOD Thu 2028-09-07):
- Markus: latency root cause + 3 bullet mitigation plan and whether we need an infra canary change before QBR.
- Laura: two slides for usage & cost anomalies: one causal note, one month-end projection for finance.
- Vivek: confirm whether the recent cache invalidation change is implicated and whether SLA exposure exists.

Proposed pre-QBR sync: Fri 2028-09-08 17:00 UTC (10:00 PT). I'll block 30m if that works.

Attachments: 2028-09-dashboard-sept.pdf (executive-ready), kpi_raw_2028-09.csv (metric dumps + comments). Drive folder link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBRprepkpi

Thanks — Chloë
Chloë Martin
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Q3 KPI preflight: dashboard + OKR check & pre-QBR asks

On Tue, 5 Sep 2028 at 16:12 +0000, Chloe Martin wrote:
> Team — attaching the monthly KPI dashboard and the raw metrics CSV for the exec QBR next week. High level items I want us to own before the pre-read goes to execs: 
> - Latency: EU p50/p95 nudged up ~10–15%

Thanks Chloe — I can take latency. Quick notes:
- Initial signal looks correlated with a model roll (v2.3) we rolled to EU pool on 2028-08-29; p95 increased during peak windows where seq lengths spiked.
- I'll pull the per-model latency histogram and KV cache hit rates (will attach by EOD Thu).
- Short mitigation: pin critical routes back to v2.2 for canary traffic, increase budgeted concurrency for EU pool, and tune batching window for 1h peak. If we pin, we can get p95 back within SLOs within 24h.

I'll also include an action item: propose a post-QBR runbook for rolling model upgrades in regionally sensitive pools.

-Markus
Principal Reliability Engineer

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Sep 2028 07:21:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Q3 KPI preflight: dashboard + OKR check & pre-QBR asks

Chloë / team —

I've started slide drafts. Notes for the usage/cost slides: 
- The Acme Health spike (recorded 2028-09-01 14:03 UTC) accounted for ~25% of the hour's peak tokens; their integration retried a webhook loop that amplified calls. I've looped in Acme (Janet) earlier today for a follow-up — cc'd on this thread.
- For finance: I'll produce a conservative month-end cost projection factoring in current burn + projected usage growth (two scenarios: baseline and high-growth).
- Recommendation: call out the APAC <3m flaps as "brief impact, resolved" and include incident IDs. No exec escalation recommended unless Acme confirms wider integration problems.

I'll drop the two slides into the Drive folder and flag them in the pre-read.

—Laura
VP, Customer Reliability

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Sep 2028 08:14:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Q3 KPI preflight: dashboard + OKR check & pre-QBR asks

Looping in a couple of infra points here:
- The cache invalidation push on 2028-08-31 had a small regression in shard balancing for APAC — I opened INF-582: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-582. That likely explains the brief APAC blips Laura noted.
- On canary: Markus, pinning back to v2.2 for EU makes sense as a near-term mitigation. I'm standing by to approve capacity increases; FYI, extra concurrency will add to cost but should be short-lived.
- I'll add a one-slide "SLA exposure & mitigation" for the pre-read that lists possible exec asks and mitigations.

Vivek
Head of Infrastructure

Thanks all — summary and next steps: 

1) Markus: latency deep-dive + per-model histograms by EOD Thu 2028-09-07. If you recommend pinning, move forward and update the runbook note.
2) Laura: usage/cost slides + month-end projection (baseline / high-growth) by EOD Thu. 
3) Vivek: INF-582 link confirmed; add SLA exposure slide and note whether short concurrency increase is needed.
4) I'll consolidate slides and send the pre-read by Fri morning UTC; pre-QBR sync Fri 2028-09-08 17:00 UTC (30m). Please add any drive links to the folder.

Attachments included in this thread: 2028-09-dashboard-sept.pdf, kpi_raw_2028-09.csv.
